long_biography.plain_text:
A former hospital site in Metz became Stéphane Noël's most ambitious test as a property developer. Representing Groupe Habiter, he joined two local partners to acquire the rights for Bon-Secours and replace the disused complex with a large urban neighbourhood. He described the scheme as a rare opportunity in a two-decade building career.

Noël's work has remained concentrated in Lorraine, combining new housing with urban renewal and mixed-tenure programmes. In 2023, Habiter transferred its property-management and co-ownership services to another regional group so that it could concentrate on development. More recent projects have paired new homes with public and institutional partners in Metz and Thionville.
